profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Highly motivated software engineer with passion for exploring new concepts and implementing them into practical, hands on applications. I bring industry experience in maintenance, development and improvisation of enterprise web applications. Feel free to get in touch with me about relevant opportunities.

Technical Skill Set:
• Programming Languages: Java, Javascript, Typescript, HTML, CSS
• Databases : Oracle SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL
• Server-Side: Spring MVC, Django, Flask, Express.js, AWS EC2
• Client-Side: ExtJS, Angular 4, JQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap
• Architecture: MVC, OOP, REST, Single Page Applications
• Software: Eclipse, Visual Studio Code
• Version Control: GIT, SVN, CVS
• Application server: Tomcat, JBoss, Web-sphere
• Issue Tracking product: JIRA
